facts.business: EKI Energy Services Ltd. is a global climate solutions and advisory company engaged in carbon credit generation, trading, and project development across 40+ countries, with a focus on voluntary and compliance carbon markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: First Carbon Credit Certificate (CCC) trading on power exchanges is expected by mid-2026

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on demerger scheme approved by Board on February 10, 2025, pending NCLT approval; financial statements prepared without considering the scheme's effect.

key_risks: Protracted global voluntary carbon market slowdown
Structural shifts in international climate policy
Complexity in valuation of carbon credit inventory involving verification of emission reductions, market pricing, regulatory compliance, vintage, and technology
